name: Imipenem + cilastatin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 500 mg every 6 hours or 1 g every 8 hours IV
500 mg over 20 to 30 minutes; 1 g over 40 to 60 minutes

key_interactions.action: Do not coadminister unless benefit outweighs risk.

key_interactions.effect: Blocks tubular secretion; higher and longer drug levels (label).
Carbapenems lower valproate levels below the therapeutic range; breakthrough seizures (label).
key_interactions.action: Generally not recommended; prefer a non-carbapenem.

pk.peak: 31 to 49 mcg/mL (500 mg) and 56 to 88 mcg/mL (1 g) after a 20-minute infusion
pk.metabolism: Cilastatin blocks renal metabolism of imipenem
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 70% of each component in urine within 10 hours
